description: Na₃CaYP₂SO₁₂ is Pb (Zr_0.50 Ti_0.48) O_3-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.91 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.67 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.90 Å. Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.39 Å. Y is bonded to six O atoms to form YO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.38 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-42°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-43°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.58 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-38°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.50 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ca and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Y and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ca, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one S atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal bipyramidal geometry to three Na, one Y, and one P atom.
